newsitem.title: USA: Allied Capital Commercial raises qtly div.
newsitem.headline: Allied Capital Commercial raises qtly div.

text.p: Allied Capital Commercial Corp said Thursday it has increased its quarterly cash dividend to $0.50 per share from $0.48 per share to shareholders of record at December 13.

The company, a real estate investment trust, also said it expected to declare an annual extra dividend of between $0.08 and $0.11 per share. The annual extra dividend will represent the company's remaining net taxable income for 1996, it said.
The quarterly cash dividend is payable December 31.
